name: Eisenberg, Rothweiler, Winkler, Eisenberg & Jeck, P.C.
category: Personal injury and medical malpractice law firm
description: Eisenberg, Rothweiler, Winkler, Eisenberg & Jeck is a Philadelphia trial firm for catastrophic injury, medical malpractice, and products liability cases, with more than $4 billion recovered through verdicts and settlements.
tagline: Catastrophic injury and medical malpractice trial lawyers

hero.headline: Philadelphia personal injury and malpractice trial lawyers
hero.sub: Aggressive representation for people who have suffered serious injury or death through another party's negligence, from a firm with more than $4 billion recovered.

offerings.heading: Cases the firm <mark>tries.</mark>
items: Automotive products liability and premises liability
Offices in Philadelphia and Cherry Hill

story.heading: Built to take on the largest defendants
paragraphs: The firm was founded to provide aggressive legal representation to those seriously injured by another party's negligence or wrongdoing, and its trial attorneys represent clients against the largest corporations in the world.
The record is public: more than $4 billion recovered through verdicts and settlements in complex catastrophic injury cases.

experience.heading: Working with the firm
items: A consultation about what happened and what the case would need.
Investigation and experts assembled by attorneys who try cases, not just settle them.
Regular contact from the team handling the matter.

feature.heading: Medical malpractice, taken to verdict
feature.text: Birth injuries, surgical errors, and missed diagnoses require attorneys who understand medicine and are prepared for trial.

closing.heading: Serious injury cases, tried by trial lawyers
